newsitem.title: USA: Ford to offer pre-owned car programs.
newsitem.headline: Ford to offer pre-owned car programs.

text.p: Ford Motor Co's Lincoln-Mercury and Ford divisions said Monday they were starting pre-owned vehicle warranty programs that eventually will be available nationwide.
The program includes inspection and servicing of the cars and Ford-backed warranties on certain cars.
"This is not just an individual, dealer program," said Ford division spokesman Dan Bedore. "It's backed by the Ford Motor Company."
The Ford division program will be launched in the spring following a regional roll-out in the southeastern United States in mid-November.

Ford cars with less than 50,000 miles that are less than four-years old and have passed an inspection are eligible for the program. Those cars will receive a one-year, 12,000-mile warranty, 24-hour assistance and a three-day, 300-mile money-back guarantee.
The Lincoln-Mercury division program will be introduced in major markets December 9.
Lincoln-Mercury cars that qualify will be backed by a two-year, 24,000-mile bumper-to-bumper warranty, Lincoln-Mercury said.
